question: Do early-stage names on the incentive board (a non-price incentive present, price not yet up 10% from the reference close) earn a positive net return over the engine's X2 one-hour hold on Alpaca paper, and more than matched no-incentive controls?
why_forward: Several board components have no usable history: option-trade flow is recorded from 2026-09-24 (Alpaca OPRA history starts 2024-02 and has no receive times), and halt and news receive times exist only from the monitor's first day. A prospective paper study is therefore the first honest test; it is preregistered here before any order and is never tuned on its own outcomes.

selection.order: score descending, then relative volume descending (missing last), then symbol

controls.pool: every name in a fresh full-market SIP snapshot at the decision time that passes the same price, spread, dollar-volume, gain and last-trade filters and is not on the board
controls.draw: sha256(protocol id | session date | decision time | symbol) ascending, first 20
controls.outcome: SIP minute bars after the session: first bar open at or after the decision time to the bar open 60 minutes later, less the measured cost table's per-side cost for the name's price tier

execution.engine: adaptive-paper mover trial mode (blueprints/us-equities/adaptive-paper, merged #172); its scan field protocol stays the engine's execution protocol mover-early-entry-v1-20260924 and the scan's source names this study
execution.exit: X2 (60 minutes after the first entry fill)

outcomes.primary: net return per round trip after fees from the engine receipt's fills
secondary: selected minus control mean one-hour model return
outcomes.test: one-sided 95% circular block bootstrap lower bound of the primary mean, blocks of 5 sessions, B = 20000, seed = int(sha256(id)[:16], 16)
outcomes.pass: lower bound > 0 and the secondary difference positive

stop_rules: the engine's own lifetime gross-loss and drawdown caps (1000 USD)
any parameter change, which starts a new protocol version instead
gate_relation: A pass is paper performance evidence for strategy-paper-performance. The live gate also requires strategy-historical-holdout, which this study cannot supply for its history-less components; whether a preregistered forward period may stand in for that holdout is an open gate decision, not assumed here.
limitations: the board score is a heuristic detector fixed on 2026-09-24 without outcome data
paper fills are simulated by Alpaca and can differ from live fills
two decisions per session share market conditions, so sessions (not trades) are the bootstrap unit
